'''Je'daii initiate'''<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> was a term which referred to a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] who was undergoing the early stages of [[Je'daii training]] at [[Padawan Kesh]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="DOTJ0" /> If they passed the [[Padawan Trial]],<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> the [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]]s advanced to the next stage of their training as the [[Padawan (Je'daii)|Padawan]] of a [[Je'daii Master]].<ref name="DOTJ0" />
